title: A warm ritual allowing real feelings

captions.physics: Keeping familiar ways of domestic care

meaning: Your domestic custom supports closeness when you need not look happy before honestly meeting each other’s present state.
text: Feeling at home may grow through familiar care: preparing a favourite, meeting in the evening and repeating a weekend ritual. The Hierophant in the physical position of Muladhara describes preserving this form. The Sun in energy tests your footing through demanding a bright response: everything is arranged, so both should feel good. The Lovers in emotions seek open acceptance and being together without a role. A custom therefore brings greater warmth when it can hold your actual state instead of first requiring joy as proof that shared domestic life has succeeded.

For example, everything is ready for familiar evening tea, but someone wants to speak about a difficult day. Immediately trying to cheer them restores the proper atmosphere only outwardly. **Closeness also begins where an evening at home is not cloudless.** You can receive care and remain upset. The ritual provides room for a real meeting, with favourite cups and a familiar table helping you be yourselves instead of imposing compulsory good moods.

The difficulty is experiencing sadness as refusal to appreciate effort. You try harder to brighten the evening, while honest feeling hides to avoid offending care. Everything looks good outside with less closeness within. Home offers steadier support when acknowledging someone’s work need not change an emotion immediately, and you can be real together without spoiling the familiar picture.
